how_to_apply: Candidates must complete the online application and ensure that the signed printed application with supporting documents reaches the DTU Recruitment Cell before the separate hard-copy deadline.
Visit the official Delhi Technological University website at www.dtu.ac.in.
Locate Advertisement No. 05/2026 for Professor and Associate Professor recruitment.
Read the advertisement and applicable discipline-specific Recruitment Rules.
Prepare Annexure-II and calculate the required Academic/Research Score.
Open the online application facility and complete the required application details.
Select the appropriate post, discipline and reservation category.
Enter the prescribed educational qualifications, experience, publications and research achievements.
Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting documents.
Complete online payment of the applicable application fee.
Review all entries carefully and submit the online application by 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Download and print the completed application form and Annexure-II.
Sign each page of the printed application and Annexure-II.
Attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates, research evidence and fee receipt.
Place all required documents in a single sealed envelope.
Send or deliver the envelope to the DTU Recruitment Cell so that it reaches by 21 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Multiple Disciplines: Candidates applying for more than one discipline must submit separate online applications and pay the prescribed fee for each discipline.
Application Correction Warning: Once an online application has been submitted, changes or corrections, including category changes, are not permitted.
important_instructions: Only eligible experience and research achievements supported by the required documents will be considered.

Eligible teaching experience includes regular faculty service or qualifying contract/ad hoc faculty service at the equivalent level in recognized higher education institutions, subject to the prescribed minimum commitment.
Industrial experience must be in an equivalent management-level position in an eligible organization.

Experience is counted from the date the applicant becomes eligible under the Recruitment Rules. The notification specifies a minimum commitment of 11 months per year and does not count individual employment periods shorter than six months.

Eligible research experience in R&D organizations or institutions is considered under the notified scoring criteria. The duration of a full-time PhD programme is excluded from the prescribed research-experience calculation.
Only publications already published online or offline by 7 December 2026 will be considered.
Research papers submitted, under peer review or accepted but not published by the closing date will not receive assessment points.
OBC candidates from outside Delhi who do not satisfy the notified Delhi OBC eligibility conditions and candidates belonging to the creamy layer must apply under the Unreserved category.
The required OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026 and no later than 7 December 2026.

EWS applicants must possess the required Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026-27, based on income for financial year 2025-26, according to the prescribed Government of Delhi conditions.
PwBD reservation operates horizontally across the applicable vertical categories. Candidates must meet the identified disability suitability requirements for the selected discipline.
Only candidates possessing the required valid benchmark disability certificates will be considered for the applicable PwBD reservation benefits.

Candidates must be Indian citizens. Applications must be submitted online before 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The printed application and supporting documents must reach DTU by 21 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. No corrections are allowed after online application submission. Separate applications and fees are required for separate disciplines. Only eligible experience, qualifications and research achievements supported by documents will be assessed. All recruitment stages involving verification, presentation and interview require personal attendance. Online document verification, presentation or interview is not permitted. Photographs must be recent, clear, in colour and taken against a plain white or off-white background. Applicants serving in Government departments, autonomous bodies or universities must apply through the proper channel. No travelling or daily allowance will be provided for document verification, presentation or interview. Updates and selection-related communication will be published on the DTU website or sent to the registered email address.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification, relevant specialization, experience and research requirements prescribed in DTU's applicable Recruitment Rules for the selected post and discipline. Candidates must meet the requirements stated in the Professor Recruitment Rules PDF . Applicants must consult the applicable official rules for their discipline. Design - Associate Professor Design Recruitment Rules . Management - Associate Professor Management Recruitment Rules . Remaining Disciplines - Associate Professor Recruitment Rules . For certain notified disciplines governed by the UGC Gazette Notification dated 18 July 2018, DTU permits a 5% relaxation at Bachelor's and Master's levels for eligible SC/ST/OBC (NCL-Delhi) and PwBD candidates. These relaxations apply subject to the specific disciplines and conditions identified in the notification. Four-year or longer B.Sc. Engineering, BE, B.Tech and BS programmes may be treated as equivalent. M.Sc. Engineering, ME, M.Tech and MS qualifications may be treated as equivalent. Relevant AMIE/IETE qualifications may be considered under the applicable Recruitment Rules. Candidates with foreign qualifications must provide AIU equivalence or recognition certificates where applicable.

content_sections.heading: DTU Research Score Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the minimum research score specified for their post and provide evidence supporting all claimed research achievements. The notification identifies the following activities for calculating academic and research scores. Research papers published in eligible indexed or approved journals. Books authored and eligible translation works. Innovative teaching pedagogy, curricula, MOOCs and electronic content. Research guidance and completed or ongoing research projects. Consultancy activities. Patents, policy documents, awards and fellowships. Invited lectures, seminars, conferences and eligible conference publications. The detailed score must be calculated according to Annexure-II and the criteria referenced from the UGC Notification dated 18 July 2018.

content_sections.heading: DTU Academic and Research Screening Score 2026
content_sections.text: The university evaluates candidates using Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores for shortlisting. The academic record is initially assessed using a 50-point schedule and scaled down to 20 points. Experience and research performance are initially assessed using a separate 50-point schedule and scaled down to 40 points. Important: The detailed marks awarded for publications, patents, research projects and related achievements depend on authorship, publication category, project value and other criteria in the notification. Candidates must calculate the score using the prescribed table rather than claiming the maximum points automatically.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DTU will select candidates through eligibility screening, academic and research evaluation, document and point verification, teaching presentation and interview. Online application and submission of the required printed documents. Initial scrutiny under the discipline-specific Recruitment Rules. Publication of provisional eligibility lists. Consideration of candidates' representations, where applicable. Shortlisting based on Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores. Original Document and Point Mark Verification. Presentation assessing teaching aptitude and ability. Interview evaluating domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection according to the prescribed assessment criteria. The university normally calls 10 candidates for the first vacancy and five candidates for each subsequent vacancy for interview, subject to recruitment requirements. Shortlisting for document verification is based on the combined 60-point score for Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance. Candidates tied at the shortlisting cut-off may also be included in the provisional shortlist according to the notification. Candidates shortlisted for verification must produce original certificates and relevant supporting evidence for the academic and research points claimed. If a candidate has not uploaded or attached evidence for a claimed assessment component, the university will award zero points for that component. Candidates unable to produce the required original documents will not be permitted to participate in the presentation and interview stages. Candidates successfully completing document and point verification must attend: Presentation: Assessment of teaching aptitude and ability. Interview: Assessment of domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection takes account of academic record, experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Experience and Publication Assessment Rules
content_sections.text: Only eligible experience and research achievements supported by the required documents will be considered. Eligible teaching experience includes regular faculty service or qualifying contract/ad hoc faculty service at the equivalent level in recognized higher education institutions, subject to the prescribed minimum commitment. Industrial experience must be in an equivalent management-level position in an eligible organization. Experience is counted from the date the applicant becomes eligible under the Recruitment Rules. The notification specifies a minimum commitment of 11 months per year and does not count individual employment periods shorter than six months. Eligible research experience in R&D organizations or institutions is considered under the notified scoring criteria. The duration of a full-time PhD programme is excluded from the prescribed research-experience calculation. Only publications already published online or offline by 7 December 2026 will be considered. Research papers submitted, under peer review or accepted but not published by the closing date will not receive assessment points.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete the online application and ensure that the signed printed application with supporting documents reaches the DTU Recruitment Cell before the separate hard-copy deadline. Multiple Disciplines: Candidates applying for more than one discipline must submit separate online applications and pay the prescribed fee for each discipline. Application Correction Warning: Once an online application has been submitted, changes or corrections, including category changes, are not permitted.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Hard Copy Submission Address
content_sections.text: The completed printed application, Annexure-II and prescribed documents must be sent to: The Recruitment Cell Room No. 818, 8th Floor, AB-3 Block, Delhi Technological University, Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road, Delhi - 110042. Last Date for Receipt: 21 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Application for the post of [Name of the Post] in the discipline of [Name of the Discipline] Important: DTU will not process applications if the printed form and required documents are not received by the deadline. Applicants should account for delivery time because the university will not accept responsibility for postal delays or losses.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Printed online application form, signed on each page. Completed Annexure-II, signed on each page. Self-attested educational qualification certificates and marksheets. Relevant teaching, research or industrial experience certificates. SC/ST/OBC/EWS category certificate, if applicable. PwBD certificate, if applicable. Front page of PhD thesis. Front pages of research publications. Documents supporting research-score and academic-score claims. Research project sanction letters and completion certificates, where applicable. Evidence supporting patents, awards, research guidance and other claimed achievements. Online application fee receipt or proof of payment. Equivalent qualification recognition certificate, where applicable. Other documents specified under the selected discipline's eligibility conditions. Candidates should retain the original documents for in-person document and point verification.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Reservation Rules
content_sections.text: OBC candidates from outside Delhi who do not satisfy the notified Delhi OBC eligibility conditions and candidates belonging to the creamy layer must apply under the Unreserved category. The required OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026 and no later than 7 December 2026. EWS applicants must possess the required Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026-27, based on income for financial year 2025-26, according to the prescribed Government of Delhi conditions. PwBD reservation operates horizontally across the applicable vertical categories. Candidates must meet the identified disability suitability requirements for the selected discipline. Only candidates possessing the required valid benchmark disability certificates will be considered for the applicable PwBD reservation benefits.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian citizens. Applications must be submitted online before 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The printed application and supporting documents must reach DTU by 21 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. No corrections are allowed after online application submission. Separate applications and fees are required for separate disciplines. Only eligible experience, qualifications and research achievements supported by documents will be assessed. All recruitment stages involving verification, presentation and interview require personal attendance. Online document verification, presentation or interview is not permitted. Photographs must be recent, clear, in colour and taken against a plain white or off-white background. Applicants serving in Government departments, autonomous bodies or universities must apply through the proper channel. No travelling or daily allowance will be provided for document verification, presentation or interview. Updates and selection-related communication will be published on the DTU website or sent to the registered email address.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Delhi Technological University (DTU) for filling up various faculty positions in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 84 vacancies have been announced for Professor and Associate Professor posts across multiple engineering, management, and science disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and end dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 23 October 2026 and closes on 7 December 2026. Candidates must complete submissions within this timeframe.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: No, there is no upper age limit prescribed for appointment to the posts of Professor and Associate Professor at Delhi Technological University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree along with relevant Master's qualifications and required academic and professional experience as per university recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee for UR and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved (UR) and OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 3000/- through online payment modes.

faq.question: Q7. Are reserved categories exempted from the application fee?
faq.answer: EWS, SC, and ST candidates pay Rs. 1000/-, while PwBD candidates are completely exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection involves document and point mark verification, a presentation to assess teaching aptitude and ability, followed by a formal personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to send a printed copy of the application form?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must submit a printed copy of their online application along with all required supporting self-attested documents by post or in person by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the physical application documents be mailed?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to The Recruitment Cell, Room No. 818, 8th Floor, AB-3 Block, Delhi Technological University, Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road, Delhi - 110042.
